messages:
Anika: quick follow-up from the postmortem — recurring OOMs on infer workers after 48-96h. pattern: slow per-shard RSS creep + fragmentation. want clear owners + small quick wins.

Anika: proposed short list (react to claim):
  1) targeted heap sampling + jemalloc/pprof captures on failing hosts (owner?) ETA 72h
  2) TTL enforcement hotfix for LRU metadata path (owner?) ETA 24-48h
  3) background soft-eviction per shard (non-blocking) + eviction metrics (owner?) ETA 5d
  4) mmap/tracing to find long-lived mmapped regions and madvise opportunities (owner?) ETA 7d
  5) fragmentation dashboard (rss/active ratio) + drift alerts and pager thresholds (owner?) ETA 3d
  6) CI regression test: long-lived-session perf job to catch regressions (owner?) ETA 2w

Ravi: I'll take 1) and 4). plan: capture pprof + smaps + jemalloc every 10m for 72h on canaries and run a simple tracer to log mmap/munmap sites. uploading to ticket INF-2025.

Sam: I'll own 2) and 3). hotfix for TTL enforcement first — if we confirm TTL bug, push to canary and monitor. eviction will be background-only and expose evictions_count and reclaimed_bytes. will ensure no request blocking.

Renee: I'll do 5) and 6). dashboard with median/p90 per-shard rss, fragmentation ratio panel, and two alerts: warn at >50MB drift over 6h, pager at >120MB drift over 4h. will add nightly long-lived-session job to ci/perf and fail builds if RSS delta regresses.

Anika: nice. Ravi paste the minimal capture bits so infra can wire a cronjob. Sam please ensure eviction has a toggle and can be rolled back. Renee coordinate alert severities with SRE.

Ravi: capture gist (full script in INF-2025):
```
PODS=$(kubectl get pods -l app=infer -o jsonpath='{.items[*].metadata.name}')
for p in $PODS; do
  kubectl exec $p -- sh -c "pprof -raw /proc/self/exe /tmp/heap.$(date +%s).pprof" || true
  kubectl exec $p -- sh -c "cat /proc/$$/smaps > /tmp/smaps.$(date +%s).txt" || true
  kubectl exec $p -- sh -c "curl -s localhost:9100/metrics | grep jemalloc" > /tmp/jemalloc.$(date +%s).txt || true
done
```
Will attach cron job link after infra-bot creates it.

oncall-bot: scheduled job JOB-2025 created to collect heap/smaps on canaries. next run in 5m.

Sam: eviction notes: background token-bucket limiter, only evict when shard resident > working_set * 1.25 for >10m. evictions reclaim small items first. adding metrics and an opt-out flag per-pool. will open a PR for review.

Ravi: mmap tracing note: initial samples show large anon mmaps pinned by a decoder cache in a couple of processes. will add tracing to record callsite and size; if madvise(DONTNEED) helps we can add a compaction path.

Renee: dashboards: adding a panel "fragmentation_ratio = rss / active_anon" and an "oom-risk" score that combines drift, p95 alloc rate, and reclaimed_bytes. pager threshold set after a 24h baseline run.

Anika: infra-bot, please create INF-2025 and assign Ravi/Sam/Renee.

infra-bot: created ticket INF-2025 "kv-cache memory drift & OOM follow-up". assignees: Ravi, Sam, Renee.

Sam: if TTL hotfix is low-risk, we can push to canary within 24h. otherwise we'll gate behind feature toggle. will include automatic rollback if canary RSS > 2x baseline in 30m.

Ravi: uploading first pprof + smaps dumps to INF-2025 now. early look: 3 hosts show steady +30MB/day growth correlated with a decoder cache mmaped region. will post details in ticket.

Renee: scheduling a 30m sync in 72h to review profiling findings, TTL hotfix status, eviction canary, and alert thresholds. I'll create the calendar invite.

Anika: thanks all. please update INF-2025 with PR links and mark subtasks done. closing loop when we have a verified mitigation and a CI regression test. :white_check_mark:
